state: CanGrant awards cash commitments, not disbursements. Its current Application has server=actor account; submitted intake fields lock when state!=draft; submit(application:Application) by=authenticated requires owner, draft, now<=grant.closes, distinct reviewer and answer count. external(application:Application,received:datetime,evidence:text,override_reason:text?) by=coordinator currently checks workplace access, draft, evidence, received<=now and timely receipt or recorded override. decide(application:Application,approve:bool,reason:text) by=reviewer requires assigned nonself reviewer, submitted state, workplace access and nonblank reason; approval checks remaining budget. New requirements are private corrections, typed complete answers, frozen decisions and server deadlines. Existing contracts, queries, locks and create/set support both choices. Question keys and prompts will be copied into each draft; Answer carries question key and nonblank text; complete validation matches each frozen key exactly once. A corrected draft is allowed before close from submitted/rejected and is private until a fresh server-timed submission; an original submitted record becomes superseded only then. Rejected decisions and withdrawal evidence remain immutable. No runtime has been implemented.

correction.instructions: Select a correction representation that best preserves intake evidence and the existing access/deadline rules while keeping authored logic simple.

criteria.linked: Create a separate Application with correction pointing to its predecessor. Copy its frozen questions and editable values; never reopen submitted intake. Prevent multiple pending correction drafts. Submission atomically supersedes a still-submitted predecessor and rechecks receipt deadline. Rejection remains final evidence. Costs: additional rows, linkage and query guards.
criteria.reopen: Move the original submitted/rejected Application back to draft, copy its receipt and decision into immutable history records, and resubmit with new authoritative receipt. Costs: revise current intake lock semantics, history projections and current-row decision lifecycle; benefits: one continuing application identity and smaller applicant list.
